column1: # How far each campaign got with each target (#605). One row per (campaign, target),
# carrying the FURTHEST stage that campaign reached. The stages, the rules that decide
# them, and what this record cannot see are on spike/outcome-funnel.py and in
# docs/outcome-funnel.md; the counts are generated from here and never typed.
# Columns (tab-separated, exactly nine, TABS not spaces):
#   campaign target stage verdict stop report evidence as_of note
#   stage     attempted explored judged novel report_worthy filed acknowledged
#   verdict   pass / fail / unknown (a named refusal) / - . A verdict is PASS or FAIL;
#             everything else is a refusal, never a silent pass (docs/target-classes.md).
#   stop      why this encounter stopped where it did, from a closed set. `known` and
#             `not_worth` are separate because they are different judgements: the
#             2026-09-16 run did not file pre-commit because no content is lost, which
#             says nothing about whether the finding was novel.
#   report    owner/repo#N, and it must be one of this project's own filings in
#             spike/upstream-reports.tsv. A third party's issue covering the same shape
#             goes in the note - it is not a report this project made. A row below
#             `filed` may still carry one: the 2026-09-05 run rediscovered a window
#             this project had filed the day before.
#   evidence  a path in this repository. Where it is a report this engine wrote, the
#             checker holds this row's verdict and stage to what that report says.
#             Where it is not, the checker holds it to existing and to naming the
#             target, and `summary` prints how many rows are in each state.
#   as_of     when the upstream state in `stop` was read. Required from `filed` on:
#             a tail state with no reading date is indistinguishable from one nobody
#             re-read, which is the failure spike/upstream-report-status.sh exists to
#             avoid. That script measures the live state; this column does not.
